proposals.before: He had first served as aide in Hedong; on business he reached the capital and lodged at a relay station.
proposals.after: He had first served as aide in Hezhong; on business he reached the capital and lodged at a relay station.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東).

proposals.before: Yisun had first been an aide in Hedong; on business he went to the capital and lodged at a relay station.
proposals.after: Yisun had first been an aide in Hezhong; on business he went to the capital and lodged at a relay station.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東).

proposals.before: Ning said, "Such men covet others' goods before the fact; when crisis comes they fall short.
proposals.after: Ning said, "By my estimate, one must seize the initiative before the other does; when the crisis arrives it is already too late.
proposals.reason: 先人有奪人之心 is the classical maxim of striking first to seize initiative, not coveting goods.

proposals.before: Fan, privy council academician, grand master, vice minister of works, supreme pillar, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households, gold-purple fish tally—once aided the late emperor with full counsel; serving me, his loyalty bends further; in service he has a great minister's form, in conduct a gentleman's learning.
proposals.after: Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor with every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving his superiors he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.
proposals.reason: Align idiomatic titles with 尚書工部侍郎 (Works, not Revenue) and the fuller official style in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works in the Ministry of Revenue, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households' fief, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor, every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving the above he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.
proposals.after: Fan, Direct Academician of the Privy Council, Grand Master of the Palace, Vice Minister of Works in the Ministry of Works, Supreme Pillar of the State, Baron of Jinyang with three hundred households' fief, bearer of the gold-purple fish tally—formerly aided the late emperor, every counsel fully offered; serving my slight person, his loyal resolve bends all the more; in serving the above he attains a great minister's form, in examining himself he is a gentleman's scholar.
proposals.reason: 工部 is the Ministry of Works, not Revenue.

decisions.reason: Chinese wraps the lacuna note in editorial brackets 〈…〉; English already states the note in ASCII, so the trailing fullwidth 〉 is a stray markup artifact and should be removed.
Same lacuna note on the literal field: 〈〉 are Chinese editorial brackets already mirrored by the English wording, and leftover 〉 corrupts the translation.
Unit 〈（案：此下有闕文。）〉 likewise uses Chinese editorial brackets; the English note should not retain a stray closing 〉.
Literal has the same markup leak after the lacuna note; removing 〉 matches the Chinese without changing meaning.
Focus unit reads 河中從事; 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東). The proposed place-name correction is exact.
Literal likewise mistranslates 河中 as Hedong; Hezhong restores the correct circuit name.

凝曰「以臣料之，先人有奪人之心，臨事即不及也」 uses the classical maxim of seizing initiative first; the original 'covet others' goods' misreads 奪人之心, and the proposed rendering matches the maxim and the following plan to prepare blank edicts in advance.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 先人有奪人之心，臨事即不及也

decisions.reason: Chinese 樞密院直學士…奉上得大臣之體，檢身為君子之儒 requires Direct Academician and the 奉上/檢身 contrast; the before flattens those into vague 'in service'/'in conduct' and omits 直 and 眇躬. The proposed fuller idiomatic restores those senses without inventing content.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 樞密院直學士、中大夫、尚書工部侍郎…逮事眇躬，愈傾忠節，奉上得大臣之體，檢身為君子之儒

decisions.reason: 尚書工部侍郎 is Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works (工部), not Revenue (戶部). Replacing Revenue with Works corrects the office name.
